column1: Shared memory (one memory connecting the four intelligences)
column2: 'Oliv’s Context Graph connects every conversation, message and activity to the right people, account and opportunity.' (https://www.oliv.ai/); 'Use MCP to give your agents access to the context Oliv builds for your accounts and opportunities.' (https://www.oliv.ai/)
column3: 'Complete context that makes AI work at enterprise scale.' (https://www.glean.com/); 'Glean turns company knowledge into action without runaway model spend.' (https://www.glean.com/)
column4: 'One governed source of GTM truth. Every Rep. Every Agent.' (https://www.spekit.com/); 'Spekit grounds every rep and every agent in the same governed source of truth' (https://www.spekit.com/solutions/chief-revenue-officers)
column5: Promise: 'Know every deal. Coach every rep. Forget nothing.'; one memory in three layers. Layer 1 ('What was said') is backed by Built call capture (calendar sync, transcripts, call summaries) and documents (Content Library); its email and Slack sources are In build / Planned. In build: 'Memory layers two and three: what calls meant, and what happened next'. Flagged by the Narrative: 'Connecting the dots (the pricing example)'.
column6: INTERPRETATION (analyst view, not capability claims): Overlap: all three claim one shared context layer. Oliv.ai is closest to PitchSense's memory story: a Context Graph that maps every conversation, message and activity to people, accounts and opportunities, offered to other agents via MCP. Glean's 'complete context' is company-wide rather than deal-specific; Spekit's 'one governed source of GTM truth' is about approved knowledge, not what was said on calls. Difference: none of the three uses 'memory' as the headline word on the inspected pages; Oliv's Process Graph page (not part of this inspection) describes a per-rep personal memory. Opportunity (testable hypothesis): a memory that ties what was said on calls to coaching and content may still be distinct from Oliv's revenue-ops context graph; test against Oliv's Context Graph and Process Graph pages before claiming it. NARRATIVE V1 RECONCILIATION (Oct 20, 2026): Built today: Layer 1 call capture (calendar sync, transcripts, call summaries) and documents (Content Library). In build: memory layers two and three; email and Slack sources are In build or Planned. 'Connecting the dots (the pricing example)' is flagged by the Narrative, so the cross-layer memory story is not a public claim yet.

column1: Cross-channel intelligence (calls, CRM, emails, Slack, documents)
column2: 'Your calls, emails, Zoom, messages, and even in-person meetings' (https://www.oliv.ai/); 'Connected to your apps: Gainsight, Salesforce, Outreach, Gong' (https://www.oliv.ai/)
column3: 'Start every task with code, tickets, logs, and docs in one context layer' (https://www.glean.com/); 'Integrated across enterprise tools your business runs on.' (https://www.glean.com/)
column4: 'Unify your deal signals, buyer data, and competitive insights so reps walk into every conversation prepared to win.' (https://www.spekit.com/); 'Connects to your stack via MCP, Extensions and Integrations.' (https://www.spekit.com/)
column5: Built: transcripts from Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Fireflies, Fathom and Granola; summaries and pre-call brief delivered to Slack; documents via the Content Library. In build: reading email for deal context (Gmail, Outlook); summaries by email and Teams; meeting bot. Planned: CRM connection (Salesforce, HubSpot) and updates; reading deal conversations in Slack; deal status from email and Slack. Flagged: 'The CRM use cases'; 'Everything about email and Slack tracking'.
column6: INTERPRETATION (analyst view, not capability claims): Overlap: Oliv.ai captures calls, emails, Zoom, messages and in-person meetings and connects Salesforce, Outreach, Gong and Gainsight; Glean indexes code, tickets, logs and docs across enterprise tools; Spekit unifies deal signals and buyer data and connects through MCP and extensions. Difference: Oliv's channel list is the broadest and the most sales-specific; Glean's is horizontal; Spekit relies on Gong for call data (per its Unified Deal Context page). Opportunity (testable hypothesis): channel breadth is table stakes against these three; what PitchSense does with calls plus documents may matter more than the list. NARRATIVE V1 RECONCILIATION (Oct 20, 2026): Built: transcripts from Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Fireflies, Fathom and Granola; Slack delivery of summaries and pre-call briefs; documents via the Content Library. Email reading, Teams/email summaries and the meeting bot are In build; CRM connection and Slack deal reading are Planned. Public copy can name calls and documents only.

column2: 'At-risk deals flagged before the review call' (https://www.oliv.ai/oliv-forecast); 'Leadership sees the number with the reasons attached.' (https://www.oliv.ai/oliv-forecast)
column3: 'Surface next steps, risks, competitive angles, and the right assets so AEs, SEs, managers, and partners stay aligned without chasing context across tools.' (https://www.glean.com/solutions/departments/sales)
column4: 'Real-time intel across every deal' (https://www.spekit.com/); 'which deals are at risk before the forecast call' (https://www.spekit.com/solutions/chief-revenue-officers)
column5: In build: deal and account pages with connected call history; deal risks (Watch / At risk); commitments tracking. Planned: agent answers about calls, deals and accounts; CRM connection. No forecasting capability at any status. Built today: list of every call, call summaries, Home, accounts and contacts created automatically.
column6: INTERPRETATION (analyst view, not capability claims): Overlap: all three surface deal risk in some form. Oliv.ai flags at-risk deals before review calls and attaches reasons to the forecast; Spekit's CRO page shows deals at risk before the forecast call; Glean's sales page surfaces 'next steps, risks'. Difference: Oliv.ai sells full forecasting against Gong and Clari; Spekit's risk view comes from buyer engagement and content usage; Glean's is a sales-page claim on a horizontal platform. Opportunity (testable hypothesis): PitchSense should not compete on deal visibility against Oliv.ai; verify Spekit's and Glean's depth before treating their claims as light. NARRATIVE V1 RECONCILIATION (Oct 20, 2026): Deal and account pages, deal risks (Watch / At risk) and commitments tracking are In build; agent answers about deals and CRM connection are Planned; there is no forecasting capability at any status. Built today: the call list, call summaries, Home, and auto-created accounts and contacts. 'Know every deal' stays out of public copy.

column2: 'Turn winning behaviors into coaching and content.' (https://www.oliv.ai/)
column3: 'Walk in as an expert with tailored materials, prepared for you by your trusted AI coworker.' (https://www.glean.com/solutions/departments/sales); 'Reuse past proposals, SOWs, and project playbooks instead of starting from scratch' (https://www.glean.com/)
column4: 'keeps every GTM resource and answer accurate with AI-first structure, content generation and governance' (https://www.spekit.com/); 'Spekit creates hyper-personalized, on-brand, and automatically updating buyer experiences grounded in the live deal.' (https://www.spekit.com/)
column5: Built: Content Library with AI search and sources ('One home for approved content'); practice built from your own documents. Planned: content suggested for each call and follow-up; sales content creation (one-pagers, decks, proposals in your brand guidelines). No approval-workflow or compliance-governance capability is listed at any status. Flagged: 'The security doc suggested from the Content Library'; 'Everything about creating one-pagers, decks and proposals'.
column6: INTERPRETATION (analyst view, not capability claims): Overlap: Spekit is a governed content platform (AI-first structure, generation, governance, auto-updating buyer experiences); Glean generates tailored materials from company knowledge; Oliv.ai turns winning call moments into coaching and content. Difference: Spekit governs approved content; Glean grounds in all company knowledge; Oliv.ai's content is call clips. Opportunity (testable hypothesis): approved content tied to practice may differentiate from Glean and Oliv.ai, but Spekit's new AI Role Play in Learning Paths is the named counterexample to test. NARRATIVE V1 RECONCILIATION (Oct 20, 2026): Built: Content Library with AI search and sources; practice built from your own documents. Planned: content suggested per call and follow-up; sales content creation. The Narrative lists no approval or compliance workflow, and flags 'The security doc suggested from the Content Library' and 'Everything about creating one-pagers, decks and proposals'.

column2: 'Flags habits that cost deals.' (https://www.oliv.ai/); 'Turn winning behaviors into coaching and content.' (https://www.oliv.ai/)
column4: 'delivers the right guidance, content, or action in the moment with coaching personalized to each deal' (https://www.spekit.com/); 'Live practice in the Learning Paths you already run' (https://www.spekit.com/)
column5: Built: AI voice roleplays (11 scenario types, 3 languages, micro roleplays); tracks; skills and scoring set by Enablement; scores with evidence on every practice session; readiness per rep and scenario; coaching suggestions for managers; one-click drills with before-and-after results. In build: pre-call drill tied to a specific upcoming call. Planned: scoring real calls on your skills. Flagged: 'Checks the score on the next real call'.

Glean shows no coaching on the inspected pages (its Meeting Coach is labelled beta on a product page that was not part of this inspection). Difference: Oliv.ai coaches from real calls without practice; Spekit pairs practice with content; neither states voice roleplay scored against Enablement-set skills on the inspected pages. Opportunity (testable hypothesis): roleplay depth may still separate PitchSense from Spekit; test against Spekit's AI Role Play post before claiming it. NARRATIVE V1 RECONCILIATION (Oct 20, 2026): Built: AI voice roleplays (11 scenario types, 3 languages, micro roleplays), tracks, Enablement-set skills and scoring, scores with evidence, readiness per rep and scenario, manager coaching suggestions, one-click drills. In build: the pre-call drill tied to a specific upcoming call. Planned: scoring real calls. 'Checks the score on the next real call' is flagged, so the call-tied angle is a proposal item with a date, not public copy.
